title:
[Crash] System.ObjectDisposedException: Cannot access a disposed object.
Object name: 'System.Timers.Timer'.
author: knavet
body_snippet:
## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.ObjectDisposedException`
**Message:** Cannot access a disposed object.
Object name: 'System.Timers.Timer'.

### Stack Trace
```
   at void System.Timers.Timer.set_Enabled(bool value)
   at void mRemoteNG.Config.Connections.Multiuser.RemoteConnectionsSyncronizer.OnUpdateCheckFinished(object sender, ConnectionsUpdateCheckFinishedEventArgs eventArgs)
   at void mRemoteNG.Config.Connections.Multiuser.FileConnectionsUpdateChecker.RaiseUpdate...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the crash report — the stack trace pinned it exactly.

**Root cause:** a race in the multiuser team-sync timer. The file/SQL "is there an update?" check runs on a background thread, and when it finishes it restarts the poll timer (`RemoteConnectionsSyncronizer.OnUpdateCheckFinished` → `_updateTimer.Start()`). Meanwhile `Dispose()` runs on the UI thread (on reload / settings change / shutdown). There was a `if (!_disposed)` check, but it wasn't atomic with the `.Start()` call — so the ...

notes: closed: timer race fixed fc3a85723, in nightly since 2026-05-26, no recurrence in 2wk
